document.title: UAD Compliance Rules - Uniform Residential Appraisal Report

rules.message: Provide the address line for the subject property physical address.
rules.rule_logic: If AddressLineText is not provided

rules.message: Provide the city name for the subject property physical address.
rules.rule_logic: If CityName is not provided

rules.message: Provide the county name for the subject property physical address.
rules.rule_logic: If CountyName is not provided

rules.message: Provide the ZIP code for the subject property physical address.
rules.rule_logic: If PostalCode is not provided

rules.message: The ZIP code for the subject property physical address must be either 5 digits, or 5 digits, a hyphen, and 4 digits (ZIP+4).
rules.rule_logic: If PostalCode is not in the required format (5 digits, or 5 digits, a hyphen, and 4 digits)

rules.message: Provide the state code for the subject property physical address.
rules.rule_logic: If StateCode is not provided

rules.message: The state code for the subject property physical address must be a valid 2-character US State or Territory Code.
rules.rule_logic: If StateCode is not a valid 2-character US State or Territory Code

rules.message: Provide the latitude for subject property. For assistance with this message, contact the appraisal software vendor.
rules.rule_logic: If LatitudeIdentifier is not provided

rules.message: Provide the longitude for subject property. For assistance with this message, contact the appraisal software vendor.
rules.rule_logic: If LongitudeIdentifier is not provided

rules.message: Provide the total number of ADUs, even if the value is 0.
rules.rule_logic: If AccessoryDwellingUnitTotalCount is not provided

rules.message: The number of 'Accessory Dwelling Units' does not equal the number of living units identified as an ADU.
rules.rule_logic: If AccessoryDwellingUnitTotalCount <> the number of instances of PROPERTY_UNIT_DETAIL with AccessoryDwellingUnitIndicator = "true"

rules.message: Provide the 'Attachment Type' for the property.
rules.rule_logic: If AttachmentType is not provided

rules.message: Provide the total number of dwellings.
rules.rule_logic: If DwellingCount is not provided

rules.message: The total number of dwellings must be at least 1.
rules.rule_logic: If DwellingCount < 1

rules.message: The total number of dwellings exceeds the total number of living units, excluding any ADUs.
rules.rule_logic: If DwellingCount > LivingUnitExcludingADUCount

rules.message: The 'Dwellings Containing Units' does not equal the number of structures identified as a dwelling.
rules.rule_logic: If DwellingCount does not equal the number of instances of IMPROVEMENT_DETAIL with ImprovementType = "Dwelling"

rules.message: Provide the total number of living units, excluding any ADUs.
rules.rule_logic: If LivingUnitExcludingADUCount is not provided

rules.message: The total number of living units, excluding any ADUs, must be at least 1.
rules.rule_logic: If LivingUnitExcludingADUCount < 1

rules.message: The 'Units Excluding ADUs' does not equal the number of living units delivered in the UAD XML.
rules.rule_logic: If LivingUnitExcludingADUCount does not equal the number of instances of PROPERTY_UNIT_DETAIL with AccessoryDwellingUnitIndicator = "false"

rules.message: Provide 'Property Rights Appraised'.
rules.rule_logic: If (PropertyInProjectIndicator = "false" or ProjectLegalStructureType = "Condominium"), and PropertyEstateType is not provided

rules.message: Provide a description when 'Property Rights Appraised' = 'Other'.
rules.rule_logic: If PropertyEstateType = "Other" and PropertyEstateTypeOtherDescription is not provided

rules.message: Indicate whether the property is located within a PUD.
rules.rule_logic: If PUDIndicator is not provided

rules.message: Provide 'Ground Rent Annual Amount'.
rules.rule_logic: If PropertyEstateType = "Leasehold" and LandOwnedInCommonIndicator = "false", and PropertyGroundLeaseAnnualAmount is not provided

rules.message: Provide the property ground lease expiration date.
rules.rule_logic: If PropertyEstateType = "Leasehold" and LandOwnedInCommonIndicator = "false", and PropertyGroundLeaseExpirationDate is not provided

rules.message: Indicate whether the property ground lease is renewable.
rules.rule_logic: If PropertyEstateType = "Leasehold" and LandOwnedInCommonIndicator = "false", and PropertyGroundLeaseRenewableIndicator is not provided

rules.message: Indicate whether the property has any special tax assessments.
rules.rule_logic: If SpecialTaxAssessmentsIndicator is not provided

rules.message: Indicate whether all ownership rights of the property are included as part of the valuation.
rules.rule_logic: If LandOwnedInCommonIndicator = "false" and AllPropertyRightsAppraisedIndicator is not provided

rules.message: Deliver this indicator as false for each ownership right that is not included in the appraisal. For assistance with this message, contact the appraisal software vendor.
rules.rule_logic: If AppraisedIndicator is not "false" in a given instance of REAL_PROPERTY_INTEREST

rules.message: Provide 'Rights Not Included'.
rules.rule_logic: If AllPropertyRightsAppraisedIndicator = "false" and (at least one instance of REAL_PROPERTY_INTEREST is not provided or PropertyPartialInterestType is not provided in a given instance of REAL_PROPERTY_INTEREST)

rules.message: Provide a description when 'Rights Not Included' = 'Other'.
rules.rule_logic: If PropertyPartialInterestType = "Other" and PropertyPartialInterestTypeOtherDescription is not provided in a given instance of REAL_PROPERTY_INTEREST

rules.message: The subject property has not been identified in the UAD XML. For assistance with this message, contact the appraisal software vendor.
rules.rule_logic: If an instance of PROPERTY is not provided with @ValuationUseType = "SubjectProperty"

rules.message: More than one property has been identified as the subject property. For assistance with this message, contact the appraisal software vendor.
rules.rule_logic: If more than one instance of PROPERTY has @ValuationUseType = "SubjectProperty"

rules.message: Provide 'ValuationUseType' for each property included in the appraisal. For assistance with this message, contact the appraisal software vendor.
rules.rule_logic: If @ValuationUseType is not provided for one or more instances of PROPERTY

rules.message: Provide 'Homeowner Responsible for all Exterior Maintenance of Dwelling(s)'.
rules.rule_logic: If HomeownerResponsibleForExteriorMaintenanceIndicator is not provided
rules.report_label: Homeowner Responsible for all Exterior Maintenance of Dwelling(s)

rules.message: Indicate whether the site is owned in common.
rules.rule_logic: If LandOwnedInCommonIndicator is not provided

rules.message: Each ValuationAnalysisCategoryType can only be delivered once. For assistance with this message, contact the appraisal software vendor.
rules.rule_logic: If there is more than one instance of VALUATION_COMMENTARY with the same ValuationAnalysisCategoryType enumeration

rules.message: Provide ValuationAnalysisCategoryType = 'PropertySpecialTaxAssessments' when there are special tax assessments. For assistance with this message, contact the appraisal software vendor.
rules.rule_logic: If SpecialTaxAssessmentsIndicator = "true", and there is no instance of VALUATION_COMMENTARY with ValuationAnalysisCategoryType = "PropertySpecialTaxAssessments"

rules.message: Provide 'Description of Special Tax Assessments and Impact to Value / Marketability'.
rules.rule_logic: If SpecialTaxAssessmentsIndicator = "true" and ValuationCommentText is not provided in the instance of VALUATION_COMMENTARY with ValuationAnalysisCategoryType = "PropertySpecialTaxAssessments"
rules.report_label: Description of Special Tax Assessments and Impact to Value / Marketability

rules.message: Indicate whether the property is located on Native American lands.
rules.rule_logic: If NativeAmericanLandsIndicator is not provided

rules.message: Provide the total number of ADUs in the sales comparable.
rules.rule_logic: If @ValuationUseType = "SalesComparable" and AccessoryDwellingUnitTotalCount is not provided

rules.message: Indicate whether the property is located in a project.
rules.rule_logic: If PropertyInProjectIndicator is not provided

rules.message: Provide the legal description or an image of the legal description.
rules.rule_logic: If ImageCategoryType = "LegalDescription" is not provided in any instance of IMAGE, and ParcelsLegalDescription is not provided

rules.message: Indicate whether the structure is a 'Dwelling' or 'Outbuilding'.
rules.rule_logic: If @ValuationUseType = "RentalComparable" and ImprovementType is not provided in a given instance of IMPROVEMENT_DETAIL

rules.message: Indicate whether the property has any amenities.
rules.rule_logic: If PropertyAmenityExistsIndicator is not provided

rules.message: Indicate whether the subject property amenities have any defects, damages, or deficiencies.
rules.rule_logic: If PropertyAmenityExistsIndicator = "true" and SubjectPropertyAmenitiesDefectsExistIndicator is not provided

rules.message: Indicate whether the structure is a 'Dwelling' or 'Outbuilding'.
rules.rule_logic: If ImprovementType is not provided in a given instance of IMPROVEMENT_DETAIL

rules.message: At least one structure on the property must be identified as a 'Dwelling'.
rules.rule_logic: If ImprovementType is not "Dwelling" in at least one instance of IMPROVEMENT_DETAIL

rules.message: Indicate whether the property is new construction.
rules.rule_logic: If NewConstructionIndicator is not provided

rules.message: Provide 'Year Built' for each dwelling.
rules.rule_logic: If ImprovementType = "Dwelling" and PropertyStructureBuiltYear is not provided in a given instance of IMPROVEMENT_DETAIL

rules.message: The property can only be considered as new construction when 'Year Built' for the dwelling(s) is within 1 year of the 'Effective Date of Appraisal'.
rules.rule_logic: If NewConstructionIndicator = "true", and PropertyStructureBuiltYear is not the same year, or within 1 year of the AppraisalReportEffectiveDate, for one or more instances of IMPROVEMENT_DETAIL with ImprovementType = "Dwelling".

rules.message: The 'Year Built' is prior to 1800. Please check for accuracy.
rules.rule_logic: If PropertyStructureBuiltYear < 1800 in a given instance of IMPROVEMENT_DETAIL with ImprovementType = "Dwelling"

rules.message: The 'Year Built' for a dwelling cannot be after 'Effective Date of Appraisal'.
rules.rule_logic: If ((ExteriorConditionRatingCode = "C1" and PropertyStructureBuiltYear > year of (AppraisalReportEffectiveDate) + 2 years ) or (ExteriorConditionRatingCode <> "C1" and PropertyStructureBuiltYear > year of (AppraisalReportEffectiveDate)) in a given instance of IMPROVEMENT_DETAIL with ImprovementType = "Dwelling"

rules.message: For each dwelling indicate whether the 'Year Built' was estimated.
rules.rule_logic: If ImprovementType = "Dwelling", and PropertyStructureBuiltYearEstimatedIndicator is not provided in a given instance of IMPROVEMENT_DETAIL

rules.message: Indicate whether the structure has a permanent heating system.
rules.rule_logic: If ImprovementType = "Outbuilding" and OutbuildingRealPropertyIndicator = "true", and LivingUnitCount = 0, and HeatingSystemExistsIndicator is not provided in a given instance of IMPROVEMENT_DETAIL

rules.message: Provide the intended functional design for each outbuilding (e.g., barn, standalone ADU, pool house).
rules.rule_logic: If ImprovementType = "Outbuilding" and OutbuildingType is not provided in a given instance of IMPROVEMENT_DETAIL

rules.message: Provide a description when 'Outbuilding Type' = 'Other'.
rules.rule_logic: If OutbuildingType = "Other" and OutbuildingTypeOtherDescription is not provided in a given instance of IMPROVEMENT_DETAIL

rules.message: The type of utility(s) that exist in the outbuilding must be included. Select 'None' if there are no utilities.
rules.rule_logic: If ImprovementType = "Outbuilding" and OutbuildingRealPropertyIndicator = "true", and (at least one instance of OUTBUILDING_UTILITY is not provided or UtilityType is not provided in a given instance of OUTBUILDING_UTILITY)

rules.message: Provide a description when utility type = 'Other'.
rules.rule_logic: If ImprovementType = "Outbuilding" and OutbuildingRealPropertyIndicator = "true" and UtilityType = "Other" and UtilityTypeOtherDescription is not provided in a given instance of OUTBUILDING_UTILITY

rules.message: Provide 'Structure Design' (e.g., Low-rise, Mid-rise, High-rise, Rowhouse / Townhouse, Semi-Detached) for each dwelling.
rules.rule_logic: If ImprovementType = "Dwelling" and AttachmentType = "Attached", and StructuralDesignType is not provided in ARCHITECTURAL_DESIGN in a given instance of IMPROVEMENT

rules.message: Provide a description when 'Structure Design' = 'Other'.
rules.rule_logic: If StructuralDesignType = "Other" and StructuralDesignTypeOtherDescription is not provided in a given instance of ARCHITECTURAL_DESIGN

rules.message: Provide 'Construction Method' (e.g., Site Built, Manufactured, Modular) for each dwelling.
rules.rule_logic: If ((ImprovementType = "Dwelling" and AttachmentType = "Detached") or (ImprovementType = "Dwelling" and AttachmentType = "Attached" and StructuralDesignType = "RowhouseTownhouse" or "SemiDetached" or "Other")), and (at least one instance of CONSTRUCTION_METHOD is not provided or ConstructionMethodType is not provided in a given instance of CONSTRUCTION_METHOD)

rules.message: Provide a description when 'Construction Method' = 'Other'.
rules.rule_logic: If ConstructionMethodType = "Other" and ConstructionMethodTypeOtherDescription is not provided in a given instance of CONSTRUCTION_METHOD

rules.message: Provide the estimated number of years of the dwelling's remaining useful life.
rules.rule_logic: If CostApproachIndicator = "true" and ImprovementType = "Dwelling" and EstimatedRemainingEconomicLifeYearsCount is not provided in a given instance of STRUCTURE_ANALYSIS_DETAIL

rules.message: The exterior feature type must be included. For assistance with this message, contact the appraisal software vendor.
rules.rule_logic: If ImprovementType = "Dwelling" and HomeownerResponsibleForExteriorMaintenanceIndicator = "true" and ImprovementComponentType is not provided in a given instance of STRUCTURE_COMPONENT_DETAIL

rules.message: Provide a description when 'Feature Type' = 'Other'.
rules.rule_logic: If ImprovementComponentType = "Other" and ImprovementComponentTypeOtherDescription is not provided in a given instance of STRUCTURE_COMPONENT_DETAIL

rules.message: Provide the foundation details (e.g., style, material) for the structure.
rules.rule_logic: If ImprovementType = "Dwelling" AND HomeownerResponsibleForExteriorMaintenanceIndicator = "true" and there is no instance of STRUCTURE_COMPONENT_DETAIL with ImprovementComponentType = "Foundation"

rules.message: Provide the materials used for the foundation.
rules.rule_logic: If ImprovementType = "Dwelling" AND HomeownerResponsibleForExteriorMaintenanceIndicator = "true" and ImprovementComponentType = "Foundation" and (at least one instance of FOUNDATION_MATERIAL is not provided or FoundationMaterialType is not provided in a given instance of FOUNDATION_MATERIAL)

rules.message: Provide a description when foundation material = 'Other'.
rules.rule_logic: If FoundationMaterialType = "Other" and FoundationMaterialTypeOtherDescription is not provided in a given instance of FOUNDATION_MATERIAL

rules.message: Provide the type of foundation.
rules.rule_logic: If ImprovementType = "Dwelling" AND HomeownerResponsibleForExteriorMaintenanceIndicator = "true" and ImprovementComponentType = "Foundation" and (at least one instance of FOUNDATION_STYLE is not provided or FoundationType is not provided in a given instance of FOUNDATION_STYLE)

rules.message: Provide a description when foundation type = 'Other'.
rules.rule_logic: If FoundationType = "Other" and FoundationTypeOtherDescription is not provided in a given instance of FOUNDATION_STYLE

rules.message: Provide the roof details (e.g., estimated age, material) for the structure.
rules.rule_logic: If ImprovementType = "Dwelling" AND HomeownerResponsibleForExteriorMaintenanceIndicator = "true" and there is no instance of STRUCTURE_COMPONENT_DETAIL with ImprovementComponentType = "Roof"

rules.message: Provide the estimated age of the roof.
rules.rule_logic: If ImprovementComponentType = "Roof" and RoofEstimatedAgeRangeType is not provided in ROOF_DETAIL

rules.message: Indicate whether the roof is observable.
rules.rule_logic: If ImprovementComponentType = "Roof" and RoofObservableIndicator is not provided in ROOF_DETAIL

rules.message: Provide the roof material.
rules.rule_logic: If ImprovementType = "Dwelling" AND HomeownerResponsibleForExteriorMaintenanceIndicator = "true" and ImprovementComponentType = "Roof" and (at least one instance of ROOF_MATERIAL is not provided or RoofMaterialType is not provided in a given instance of ROOF_MATERIAL)

rules.message: Provide a description when roof material = 'Other'.
rules.rule_logic: If RoofMaterialType = "Other" and RoofMaterialTypeOtherDescription is not provided in a given instance of ROOF_MATERIAL

rules.message: Provide additional description for the exterior feature being referenced.
rules.rule_logic: If ImprovementType = "Dwelling", and HomeownerResponsibleForExteriorMaintenanceIndicator = "true", and ImprovementComponentType = "Windows" or "Other", and ImprovementComponentTypeAdditionalDescription is not provided in a given instance of STRUCTURE_COMPONENT_DETAIL

rules.message: Provide the 'Condition Status'.
rules.rule_logic: If (ImprovementType = "Dwelling" and ImprovementComponentType <> "Roof"), or (ImprovementType = "Dwelling" and ImprovementComponentType = "Roof" and RoofObservableIndicator = "true"), and ImprovementComponentConditionStatusType is not provided in a given instance of STRUCTURE_COMPONENT_DETAIL

rules.message: Provide the exterior walls and trim details (e.g., material) for the structure.
rules.rule_logic: If ImprovementType = "Dwelling" AND HomeownerResponsibleForExteriorMaintenanceIndicator = "true" and there is no instance of STRUCTURE_COMPONENT_DETAIL with ImprovementComponentType = "'ExteriorWallsAndTrim"

rules.message: Provide the exterior wall material type.
rules.rule_logic: If ImprovementType = "Dwelling" AND HomeownerResponsibleForExteriorMaintenanceIndicator = "true" and ImprovementComponentType = "ExteriorWallsAndTrim" and (at least one instance of EXTERIOR_WALL is not provided or WallMaterialType is not provided in a given instance of EXTERIOR_WALL)

rules.message: Provide a description when exterior wall material = 'Other'.
rules.rule_logic: If WallMaterialType = "Other" and WallMaterialTypeOtherDescription is not provided in a given instance of EXTERIOR_WALL

rules.message: Indicate whether the rowhouse / townhouse is an end unit.
rules.rule_logic: If StructuralDesignType = "RowhouseTownhouse" and RowhouseTownhouseEndUnitIndicator is not provided in a given instance of STRUCTURE_DETAIL

rules.message: Provide the 'Gross Building Area' of the outbuilding.
rules.rule_logic: If ImprovementType = "Outbuilding" and OutbuildingRealPropertyIndicator = "true", and StructureAreaMeasure is not provided in a given instance of STRUCTURE_DETAIL

rules.message: Provide the number of living units in the structure.
rules.rule_logic:
If ImprovementType = "Dwelling" or 
(ImprovementType = "Outbuilding" and OutbuildingRealPropertyIndicator = "true"), and LivingUnitCount is not provided in a given instance of STRUCTURE_DETAIL

rules.message: The number of living units cannot be 0 for any dwelling.
rules.rule_logic: If ImprovementType = "Dwelling" and LivingUnitCount = 0 in a given instance of STRUCTURE_DETAIL

rules.message: The number of living units in the structure does not equal the number of units delivered in the UAD XML for the structure. For assistance with this message, contact the appraisal software vendor.
rules.rule_logic: For each IMPROVEMENT, if LivingUnitCount <> the number of instances of PROPERTY_UNIT

rules.message: Provide the number of 'Floors in Building'.
rules.rule_logic: If StructuralDesignType = "Highrise" or "Midrise", and StoriesCount is not provided in a given instance of STRUCTURE_DETAIL

rules.message: Indicate whether the factory-built certification has been examined for an on-frame modular or modular home.
rules.rule_logic: If ImprovementType = "Dwelling", and ConstructionMethodType = "Modular" or "OnFrameModular", and FactoryBuiltCertificationExaminedIndicator is not provided in a given instance of STRUCTURE_DETAIL

rules.message: Provide the heating system type. Select 'None' if there is no heating system.
rules.rule_logic: If ImprovementType = "Dwelling" or (ImprovementType = "Outbuilding" and OutbuildingRealPropertyIndicator = "true" and LivingUnitCount > 0), and (at least one instance of HEATING_SYSTEM is not provided or HeatingSystemType is not provided in a given instance of HEATING_SYSTEM)

rules.message: Provide a description when heating system type = 'Other'.
rules.rule_logic: If HeatingSystemType = "Other" and HeatingSystemTypeOtherDescription is not provided in a given instance of HEATING_SYSTEM

rules.message: When 'Units Excluding ADUs' is more than 1, the structure identifier must be provided for each dwelling.
rules.rule_logic: If ImprovementType = "Dwelling" and LivingUnitExcludingADUCount > 1, and StructureIdentifier is not provided in a given instance of STRUCTURE_DETAIL

rules.message: The structure identifier must be unique.
rules.rule_logic: If StructureIdentifier is not unique across all instances of STRUCTURE_DETAIL

rules.message: The structure identifier must be unique.
rules.rule_logic: If @ValuationUseType = "SalesComparable" and StructureIdentifier is not unique across all instances of IMPROVEMENT/STRUCTURE/STRUCTURE_DETAIL for a given comp
rules.report_subsection: Unit(s); Exterior Quality and Condition; Interior Quality and Condition

rules.message: Indicate whether the outbuilding has any defects, damages, or deficiencies.
rules.rule_logic: If ImprovementType = "Outbuilding" and OutbuildingRealPropertyIndicator = "true" and OutbuildingDefectsExistIndicator is not provided in a given instance of IMPROVEMENT_DETAIL

rules.message: Provide the finished area of the outbuilding, even if the value is 0.
rules.rule_logic: If ImprovementType = "Outbuilding" and OutbuildingRealPropertyIndicator = "true" and StructureExcludingVehicleStorageAndADUFinishedAreaMeasure is not provided in a given instance of STRUCTURE_DETAIL

rules.message: Provide the unfinished area of the outbuilding, even if the value is 0.
rules.rule_logic: If ImprovementType = "Outbuilding" and OutbuildingRealPropertyIndicator = "true" and StructureExcludingVehicleStorageAndADUUnfinishedAreaMeasure is not provided in a given instance of STRUCTURE_DETAIL

rules.message: Indicate whether the dwelling has any non-continuous finished area (e.g., a finished office above, below, or behind an attached garage that cannot be accessed from within any living unit).
rules.rule_logic: If ImprovementType = "Dwelling" and LivingUnitExcludingADUCount = 1, and NonContinuousFinishedAreaIndicator is not provided in in a given instance of IMPROVEMENT_DETAIL

rules.message: Indicate whether the core heating system for dwelling is located below grade.
rules.rule_logic: If ImprovementType = "Dwelling" and HeatingSystemType <> "None", and CoreHeatingSystemBelowGradeIndicator is not provided in SYSTEM_DETAIL for a given instance of IMPROVEMENT

rules.message: Provide the approximate elevation range from grade level to the bottom of the front entrance door of the dwelling.
rules.rule_logic: If FrontDoorApproximateElevationRangeType is not provided in STRUCTURE_DETAIL for a given instance of IMRPOVEMENT with ImprovementType = "Dwelling"

rules.message: The manufactured home certification program name (e.g., Fannie Mae MH Advantage, Freddie Mac CHOICEHome) must be included when the manufactured home certification program identifier has been delivered.
rules.rule_logic: If ManufacturedHomeFinancingProgramEligibilityIdentifier is provided and ManufacturedHomeFinancingProgramEligibilityType is not provided in a given instance of MANUFACTURED_HOME_FINANCING_PROGRAM

rules.message: The manufactured home certification program identifier must be included when the manufactured home certification program name (e.g., Fannie Mae MH Advantage, Freddie Mac CHOICEHome) has been delivered.
rules.rule_logic: If ManufacturedHomeFinancingProgramEligibilityType is provided and ManufacturedHomeFinancingProgramEligibilityIdentifier is not provided in a given instance of MANUFACTURED_HOME_FINANCING_PROGRAM

rules.message: Provide a description when 'Manufactured Home Certification Program' = 'Other'.
rules.rule_logic: If ManufacturedHomeFinancingProgramEligibilityType = "Other" and ManufacturedHomeFinancingProgramEligibilityTypeOtherDescription is not provided in a given instance of MANUFACTURED_HOME_FINANCING_PROGRAM

rules.message: Indicate whether the manufactured home is attached to a permanent foundation.
rules.rule_logic: If (ImprovementType = "Dwelling" and ConstructionMethodType = "Manufactured") or (ImprovementType = "Outbuilding" and OutbuildingType = "ManufacturedHome"), and ManufacturedHomeAttachedToFoundationIndicator is not provided in a given instance of MANUFACTURED_HOME_DETAIL

rules.message: Indicate whether the towing hitch, wheels and axles have been removed from the frame of the manufactured home.
rules.rule_logic: If (ImprovementType = "Dwelling" and ConstructionMethodType = "Manufactured") or (ImprovementType = "Outbuilding" and OutbuildingType = "ManufacturedHome" and OutbuildingRealPropertyIndicator = "true" and LivingUnitCount > 0), and ManufacturedHomeHitchWheelsAxlesRemovedIndicator is not provided in a given instance of MANUFACTURED_HOME_DETAIL

rules.message: Indicate whether the HUD certification label is present for each section of the manufactured home.
rules.rule_logic: If (ImprovementType = "Dwelling" and ConstructionMethodType = "Manufactured") or (ImprovementType = "Outbuilding" and OutbuildingType = "ManufacturedHome" and OutbuildingRealPropertyIndicator = "true" and LivingUnitCount > 0), and ManufacturedHomeHUDCertificateLabelIndicator is not provided in a given instance of MANUFACTURED_HOME_DETAIL

rules.message: Indicate whether the HUD data plate is attached to the manufactured home.
rules.rule_logic: If (ImprovementType = "Dwelling" and ConstructionMethodType = "Manufactured") or (ImprovementType = "Outbuilding" and OutbuildingType = "ManufacturedHome" and OutbuildingRealPropertyIndicator = "true" and LivingUnitCount > 0), and ManufacturedHomeHUDDataPlateAttachedIndicator is not provided in a given instance of MANUFACTURED_HOME_DETAIL

rules.message: Provide the year (YYYY format) in which the manufactured home was installed.
rules.rule_logic: If ImprovementType = "Dwelling" and ConstructionMethodType = "Manufactured", and ManufacturedHomeInstalledDate is not provided in a given instance of MANUFACTURED_HOME_DETAIL

rules.message: Indicate whether the content of the manufacturer's or retailer's invoice appears reasonable.
rules.rule_logic: If ImprovementType = "Dwelling" and ConstructionMethod = "Manufactured" and (ManufacturedHomeRetailerInvoiceReviewedIndicator = "true" or ManufacturedHomeInvoiceReviewedIndicator = "true") and ManufacturedHomeInvoiceReasonableIndicator is not provided in a given instance of MANUFACTURED_HOME_DETAIL

rules.message: Indicate whether the Appraiser has reviewed and analyzed the manufactured home manufacturer's invoice.
rules.rule_logic: If ImprovementType = "Dwelling", and ConstructionMethodType = "Manufactured", and NewConstructionIndicator = "true", and ManufacturedHomeInvoiceReviewedIndicator is not provided in a given instance of MANUFACTURED_HOME_DETAIL

rules.message: Provide the date the manufactured home was built as noted on the HUD data plate.
rules.rule_logic: If ImprovementType = "Dwelling" and ConstructionMethod = "Manufactured" and ManufacturedHomeHUDDataPlateAttachedIndicator = "true", and ManufacturedHomeManufactureDate is not provided

rules.message: The 'Date of Manufacture' is prior to 1976. Please check for accuracy.
rules.rule_logic: If ManufacturedHomeManufactureDate < 1976 in a given instance of MANUFACTURED_HOME_DETAIL

rules.message: Indicate whether any modifications, attachments or additions (e.g., deck, porch, garage) have been made to the manufactured home.
rules.rule_logic: If (ImprovementType = "Dwelling" and ConstructionMethodType = "Manufactured") or (ImprovementType = "Outbuilding" and OutbuildingType = "ManufacturedHome" and OutbuildingRealPropertyIndicator = "true" and LivingUnitCount > 0), and ManufacturedHomeModificationIndicator is not provided in a given instance of MANUFACTURED_HOME_DETAIL
rules.report_label: Have there been any modifications, attachments or additions that rely on or have altered the original structure for support?

rules.message: Indicate whether the manufactured home has been moved to a different location than the one on which it was originally installed.
rules.rule_logic: If ImprovementType = "Dwelling" and ConstructionMethodType = "Manufactured", and ManufacturedHomeMovedAfterOriginalInstallationIndicator is not provided in a given instance of MANUFACTURED_HOME_DETAIL

rules.message: Indicate whether the manufactured home was purchased from a retailer.
rules.rule_logic: If ImprovementType = "Dwelling", and ConstructionMethodType = "Manufactured", and NewConstructionIndicator = "true", and ManufacturedHomePurchasedFromRetailerIndicator is not provided in a given instance of MANUFACTURED_HOME_DETAIL

rules.message: Indicate whether the Appraiser has reviewed and analyzed the manufactured home retailer's invoice.
rules.rule_logic: If ImprovementType = "Dwelling", and ConstructionMethod = "Manufactured", and ManufacturedHomePurchasedFromRetailerIndicator = "true", and ManufacturedHomeRetailerInvoiceReviewedIndicator is not provided in a given instance of MANUFACTURED_HOME_DETAIL

rules.message: Provide the 'HUD Roof Load Zone'.
rules.rule_logic: If ImprovementType = "Dwelling" and ConstructionMethod = "Manufactured" and ManufacturedHomeHUDDataPlateAttachedIndicator = "true", and RoofLoadZoneCode is not provided in a given instance of MANUFACTURED_HOME_DETAIL

rules.message: Indicate whether skirting exists for the manufactured home.
rules.rule_logic: If ImprovementType = "Dwelling", and ConstructionMethodType = "Manufactured", and SkirtingExistsIndicator is not provided in a given instance of MANUFACTURED_HOME_DETAIL

rules.message: Provide the 'HUD Thermal Zone'.
rules.rule_logic: If ImprovementType = "Dwelling" and ConstructionMethod = "Manufactured" and ManufacturedHomeHUDDataPlateAttachedIndicator = "true", and ThermalZoneCode is not provided

rules.message: Provide the 'HUD Wind Zone'.
rules.rule_logic: If ImprovementType = "Dwelling" and ConstructionMethod = "Manufactured" and ManufacturedHomeHUDDataPlateAttachedIndicator = "true", and WindZoneCode is not provided in a given instance of MANUFACTURED_HOME_DETAIL

rules.message: Provide the type of attachment, modification or addition (e.g., deck, porch, garage) made to the manufactured home.

rules.rule_logic: If PartyRoleType = "Appraiser" or "AppraiserSupervisor" and there is no instance of RELATIONSHIP provided for each role that links INSPECTION to the associated ROLE.

rules.message: The latitude must be a value between -90 and 90 with at least 5 digits of precision to the right of the decimal point. For assistance with this message, contact the appraisal software vendor.
rules.rule_logic: If @ValuationUseType = "SalesComparable" and LatitudeIdentifier is not provided between -90 and 90 with at least 5 digits of precision to the right of the decimal point

rules.message: The longitude must be a value between -180 and 180 with at least 5 digits of precision to the right of the decimal point. For assistance with this message, contact the appraisal software vendor.
rules.rule_logic: If @ValuationUseType = "SalesComparable" and LongitudeIdentifier is not provided between -180 and 180 with at least 5 digits of precision to the right of the decimal point

rules.message: Indicate whether a reconsideration of value has been requested.
rules.rule_logic: If ReconsiderationOfValueIndicator is not provided

rules.message: Provide the commentary on the outcome of the reconsideration of value.
rules.rule_logic: If ReconsiderationOfValueIndicator = "true" and ReconsiderationOfValueCommentDescription is not provided

rules.message: Provide the party that initiated the request for reconsideration of value.
rules.rule_logic: If ReconsiderationOfValueIndicator = "true" and ReconsiderationOfValueRequestedByType is not provided

rules.message: Indicate whether the reconsideration of value request resulted in a change to the Opinion of Market Value.
rules.rule_logic: If ReconsiderationOfValueIndicator = "true" and ReconsiderationOfValueResultType is not provided

rules.message: Provide the date the appraiser completed the reconsideration of value.
rules.rule_logic: If ReconsiderationOfValueIndicator = "true" and ReconsiderationOfValueResultDate is not provided

rules.message: The reconsideration of value date must include year, month and day.
rules.rule_logic: If ReconsiderationOfValueResultDate does not include year, month and day YYYY-MM-DD format

rules.message: The reconsideration of value date must be on or after the 'Effective Date of Appraisal'.
rules.rule_logic: If ReconsiderationOfValueResultDate < AppraisalReportEffectiveDate

rules.message: The reconsideration of value date cannot be more than a year old.
rules.rule_logic: If ReconsiderationOfValueResultDate is more than 367 days before the current date

rules.message: Only one line-item adjustment is allowed for this Adjustment Type.
rules.rule_logic: If @ValuationUseType = "SalesComparable" and there is more than one instance of COMPARABLE_ADJUSTMENT with the same ComparableAdjustmentType enumeration that should only be adjusted once (e.g., View). Please refer to the Adjustments Cardinality tab for the list of adjustments that can be applied only once.

rules.message: More than one Supervisory Appraiser has been identified in the appraisal. There can be only one Supervisory Appraiser.
rules.rule_logic: If more than one instance of ROLE_DETAIL has PartyRoleType = "AppraiserSupervisor" across all instances of PARTY

rules.message: Provide 'Reconciliation of Sales Comparison Approach' when sales comparison approach is included in the appraisal.
rules.rule_logic: If SalesComparisonApproachIndicator = "true" and SalesComparisonCommentDescription is not provided

rules.message: Provide 'Cost Approach Commentary' when cost approach is included in the appraisal.
rules.rule_logic: If CostApproachIndicator = "true" and CostAnalysisCommentDescription is not provided

rules.message: Provide 'Income Approach Commentary' when income approach is included in the appraisal.
rules.rule_logic: If IncomeApproachIndicator = "true" and IncomeAnalysisCommentDescription is not provided

rules.message: Provide 'Rental Analysis Commentary' when rent schedule is included in the appraisal.
rules.rule_logic: If RentScheduleIndicator = "true" and there is no instance of VALUATION_COMMENTARY with ValuationAnalysisCategoryType = "ComparableRental" and ValuationCommentText

rules.message: Each dwelling must contain at least one living unit.
rules.rule_logic: If ImprovementType = ‘Dwelling’ and there are no instances of PROPERTY_UNIT

rules.message: The commentary provided for the specified field exceeds the allowable limit of 140 characters.
rules.rule_logic: If ValuationAnalysisCategoryType = ("HazardZones" or "PropertyNonResidentialUses") and ValuationCommentText length exceeds 140 characters
rules.report_subsection: Site Features and Impact to Value / Marketability

rules.message: The commentary provided for the specified field exceeds the allowable limit of 210 characters.
rules.rule_logic: If ValuationAnalysisCategoryType = ("ProjectDeveloperOrSponsorControlsProjectManagement" or "IncompleteProject" or "ProjectConversion" or "SingleEntityGreatestNumberOfUnitsOwned" or "SingleEntityGreatestNumberOfSharesOwned" or "ProjectCommercialSpace" or "ProjectLegalAction" or "ProjectSpecialAssessmentsAttributedToSubjectProperty" or "TransferFeeAttributedToSubjectProperty" or "PropertyTaxAbatementsOrExemptions") and ValuationCommentText length exceeds 210 characters

rules.message: The commentary provided for the specified field exceeds the allowable limit of 540 characters.
rules.rule_logic: If ValuationAnalysisCategoryType = "PropertySpecialTaxAssessments" and ValuationCommentText length exceeds 540 characters
rules.report_label: Description of Special Tax Assessments and Impact to Value / Marketability

rules.message: The commentary provided for the specified field exceeds the allowable limit of 2500 characters.
rules.rule_logic: If ValuationAnalysisCategoryType = ("ProjectFactors" or "Project" or "WaterFrontages" or "SiteFeatures" or "SiteViews" or "SiteInfluences") and ValuationCommentText length exceeds 2500 characters

rules.message: Provide 'Site Influence (Location)' for the sales comparable.
rules.rule_logic: If @ValuationUseType = "SalesComparable" and (at least one instance of SITE_INFLUENCE_DETAIL is not provided or SiteInfluenceType is not provided in a given instance of SITE_INFLUENCE_DETAIL)

rules.message: Provide a description when 'Site Influence (Location)' = 'Other'.
rules.rule_logic: If SiteInfluenceType = "Other" and SiteInfluenceTypeOtherDescription is not provided in a given instance of SITE_INFLUENCE_DETAIL

rules.message: Provide the 'Transfer Terms' for the associated transaction.
rules.rule_logic: If @ValuationUseType = "SalesComparable" and OwnershipTransferTransactionType = "Sale" and SaleType is not provided in a given instance of SALES_HISTORY

rules.message: Provide 'Floor Number' for the sales comparable.
rules.rule_logic: If @ValuationUseType = "SalesComparable" and  ImprovementType = "Dwelling" and AttachmentType = "Attached" and StructuralDesignType = ("Lowrise" or "Highrise" or "Midrise"), and FloorIdentifier is not provided in a given instance of PROPERTY_UNIT_DETAIL

rules.message: Provide 'Property Rights Appraised' for the sales comparable.
rules.rule_logic: If @ValuationUseType = "SalesComparable" and (PropertyInProjectIndicator = "false" or (PropertyInProjectIndicator = "true" and ProjectLegalStructureType = "Condominium")), and PropertyEstateType is not provided

rules.message: Provide 'Construction Method' (e.g., Site Built, Manufactured, Modular) for each dwelling of the sales comparable.
rules.rule_logic: If @ValuationUseType = "SalesComparable" and ((ImprovementType = "Dwelling" and AttachmentType = "Detached") or (ImprovementType = "Dwelling" and AttachmentType = "Attached" and StructuralDesignType = "RowhouseTownhouse" or "SemiDetached" or "Other")), and (at least one instance of CONSTRUCTION_METHOD is not provided or ConstructionMethodType is not provided in a given instance of CONSTRUCTION_METHOD)

rules.message: Provide the 'Manufactured Home Width' (i.e., Single Wide, Multi Wide) for the sales comparable.
rules.rule_logic: If @ValuationUseType = "SalesComparable" and ImprovementType = "Dwelling" and ConstructionMethodType = "Manufactured" and ManufacturedHomeWidthType is not provided

rules.message: Provide the 'Unfinished Area Below Grade' for the sales comparable, even if the value is 0.
rules.rule_logic: If @ValuationUseType = "SalesComparable" and (ImprovementType = "Dwelling" or (ImprovementType = "Outbuilding" and OutbuildingRealPropertyIndicator = "true" and AccessoryDwellingUnitIndicator = "true")), and UnitBelowGradeUnfinishedAreaMeasure is not provided in a given instance of PROPERTY_UNIT_AREA

rules.message: Provide the 'Finished Area Below Grade (Nonstandard)' for the sales comparable, even if the value is 0.
rules.rule_logic: If (@ValuationUseType  = "SalesComparable" or @ValuationUseType = "SubjectProperty") and (ImprovementType = "Dwelling" or  (ImprovementType = "Outbuilding" and  OutbuildingRealPropertyIndicator = "true" and AccessoryDwellingUnitIndicator = "true")) and  ((UnitNonStandardBelowGradeFinishedAreaMeasure > 0 for @ValuationUseType = "SubjectProperty") and UnitNonStandardBelowGradeFinishedAreaMeasure is not provided in the comparable instance of PROPERTY_UNIT_AREA that was compared with the subject unit)

rules.message: Provide the 'Unfinished Area Above Grade' for the sales comparable, even if the value is 0.
rules.rule_logic: If (@ValuationUseType  = "SalesComparable" or @ValuationUseType = "SubjectProperty") and (ImprovementType = "Dwelling" or  (ImprovementType = "Outbuilding" and  OutbuildingRealPropertyIndicator = "true" and AccessoryDwellingUnitIndicator = "true")) and  ((UnitAboveGradeUnfinishedAreaMeasure > 0 for @ValuationUseType = "SubjectProperty") and UnitAboveGradeUnfinishedAreaMeasure is not provided in the comparable instance of PROPERTY_UNIT_AREA that was compared with the subject unit)

rules.message: Provide the 'Finished Area Above Grade (Nonstandard)' for the sales comparable, even if the value is 0.
rules.rule_logic: If (@ValuationUseType  = "SalesComparable" or @ValuationUseType = "SubjectProperty") and (ImprovementType = "Dwelling" or  (ImprovementType = "Outbuilding" and OutbuildingRealPropertyIndicator = "true" and AccessoryDwellingUnitIndicator = "true")) and  ((UnitNonStandardAboveGradeFinishedAreaMeasure > 0 for @ValuationUseType = "SubjectProperty") and UnitNonStandardAboveGradeFinishedAreaMeasure is not provided in the comparable instance of PROPERTY_UNIT_AREA that was compared with the subject unit)
